question: In undergraduate STEM courses, does retrieval practice (quizzing or practice testing) improve course exam performance compared with restudy or no-quiz instruction?
include: Undergraduate students in a credit-bearing STEM, health-science, or statistics course
A retrieval-practice intervention (quizzing, practice testing, spaced retrieval)
A comparison condition (restudy, review, or no quizzing)
A course exam or course-embedded test as an outcome
exclude: No new empirical data (narrative reviews, commentaries)
No intervention or no comparison condition
Laboratory-only outcomes not tied to a course
